description: Use this when the user asks what their Phorme plan has for today or the coming days, for example "what is my workout today". It returns each planned session with its exercises, sets, reps and the loads Phorme set from their own maxes. It reads only and changes nothing, including the plan. It needs a connected Phorme account. Weights are in pounds.

days.description: How many days ahead, starting today. Defaults to 7.

name: get_planned_sessions

plan.description: The name of the plan they follow.

sessions.description: In date order: on, title, status, minutes and exercises with sets, target, load and note.

title: Get my planned Phorme sessions
